title: Training a Tennis Bot
body:
I’m making a fast simulator to train and test a bot for AIA’s Studio Tennis competition, which uses Tennis v0.12 bot saves.

[video: A 21-second capture of the current Tennis bot simulator.](../media/aia-tennis-2026-09-06-training-a-tennis-bot/aia-tennis-bot-simulator.webm)
